summary: Frontend-only testing of new 'Insights from Dr. Soni' section on landing page. All 8 requested behaviors verified: section presence & correct order (after final-cta, before footer), 6-card layered stack with dots/arrows/prev/next, dot jumping, click-to-open modal with full caption (line-clamp-2 preview vs full 333-char modal caption), modal prev/next/close, Escape-to-close, no instagram.com links, and Hindi translation of title/sub/card/modal. Regression checks for selfcheck-section, final-cta-section, and hero passed. NO issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: front card renders with `key={index}` inside AnimatePresence but also drags on the same node — click-vs-drag guard via movedRef works well; consider `dragMomentum={false}` for cleaner UX.
The Chapter component receives `title={t.nav.home}` for the Insights section; probably should be a distinct 'Insights' label rather than 'Home' — minor semantic nit.
Peek layers use fixed images from items[index+1] / items[index+2] which is fine; consider adding `loading="lazy"` on Insight images to reduce initial payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Insights section fully functional. Note: card preview p tag uses inner_text which returns full text even when CSS-clamped — use clientHeight vs scrollHeight or computed webkitLineClamp to verify truncation, not inner_text length.
